summary: Global search in the titlebar: a live 'search everywhere' dropdown that jumps to pages, System Settings sections (deep-linked to the right step), and titlebar/nav actions, with an optional data-record provider — all permission-aware, translated, and theme/RTL-ready. Configured under System Settings > Titlebar > Global Search (always / icon-on-focus / disabled, plus an include-data toggle). Also bundles session-lifecycle controls (sign out on browser close; configurable inactivity timeout with a countdown modal) and a microsys->dlux branding-media migration fix. No migrations; inline-safe (auth_config + titlebar_config JSON keys).
highlights: New titlebar global search: jump to any page, setting, or action as you type (Ctrl/Cmd-K), with optional data-record search.
Settings results deep-link straight to the right settings step — no more hunting for where an option lives.
Sign out on browser close, plus a configurable inactivity timeout with a 30-second countdown warning.
Fixes migrated django-microsys logos that 404'd by relocating branding media to dlux/branding/.
